title: अनुसन्धान प्रस्तावका आवश्यक अङ्गहरू {Essential Components of a Research Proposal}
nepali: संसारमा देखिएको विभिन्न समस्याको समाधान अनुसन्धानबाटै गरिन्छ । प्राज्ञिक तथा शैक्षिक क्षेत्रमा गरिने शोधअध्ययनले समस्याको समाधान गरी नयाँ तथ्य पत्ता लगाउनु र पुरानो तथ्यको परीक्षण र पुनरव्याख्या गर्नु हो । शोधलाई गवेषण, अन्वेषण र आविष्कार पनि भनिन्छ । प्राज्ञिक क्षेत्रमा उठेका समस्या र त्यसका समाधान गर्न शोधप्रस्तावको आवश्यक हुन्छ । शोधप्रस्ताव कुनै पनि तहको उपाधि प्राप्तिको लागि विषयशीर्षकको छनोट गरी त्यसको समस्या समाधानमा केन्द्रित हुन लेखिन्छ । शोधप्रस्तावको लेखनको मुख्य उद्देश्य समस्याको समाधान नै हो । शैक्षिक तथा प्राज्ञिक क्षेत्रमा स्नातकोत्तर, एम.फिल तथा विद्यावारिधि तहको उपाधि प्राप्तिको लागि भाषा, साहित्य, राजनीतिशास्त्र, समाजशास्त्र, भूगोल, दर्शनशास्त्र र अर्थशास्त्र विषयमा लेखिन्छ । शोधप्रस्ताव विश्वविद्यालयको सम्बन्धित विषयको विभाग वा डीन कार्यालयमा प्रस्तुत गर्नुपर्छ । उक्त शोधप्रस्ताव विभाग वा डीन कार्यालयद्वारा स्वीकृत भएपछि मात्र शोध गर्नुपर्छ । शोधप्रस्ताव अनुसन्धानको वैज्ञानिक र विधिसम्मत तथा क्रमबद्घ रूपको विशिष्ट प्रक्रियामा हुनुपर्छ । यसमा अध्ययनको क्षेत्र, शोधशीर्षक, शोधको समस्याकथन, शोधको उद्देश्य, पूर्वकार्यको समीक्षा, शोधको औचित्य र उपयोगिता, शोधको सीमाङ्कन, तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलनका स्रोत (प्राथमिक र द्वितीय स्रोत), शोधको सैद्घान्तिक ढाँचा तथा शोधविधि (गुणात्मक र परिमाणात्म) र शोधको रूपरेखा शोधप्रस्तावमा हुनुपर्छ ।
american_english: The resolution of various problems seen in the world is achieved precisely through research. Research study conducted in the academic and educational sectors solves problems, discovers new facts, and tests and reinterprets old facts. Research is also called investigation, inquiry, and invention. A research proposal is necessary to address problems arising in the academic field and to solve them. A research proposal is written to select a topic title and focus on solving its problems toward earning a degree at any level. The main objective of writing a research proposal is indeed problem-solving. In the educational and academic spheres, it is written in subjects including language, literature, political science, sociology, geography, philosophy, and economics for earning Master's, M.Phil., and Ph.D. degrees. The research proposal must be submitted to the department of the relevant subject or to the Dean's office of the university. Research should be undertaken only after the said research proposal has been approved by the department or the Dean's office. A research proposal must follow a specialized process that is scientific, methodical, and sequential in research. In it, the field of study, research title, research problem statement, research objectives, review of prior work, rationale and utility of research, delimitations of research, data collection sources (primary and secondary sources), theoretical framework and research methodology (qualitative and quantitative), and research outline must be included in the research proposal.
british_english: The solution to various problems observed in the world is attained through research alone. Research studies undertaken in academic and educational sectors serve to resolve problems, discover new facts, and examine and reinterpret established facts. Research is also termed investigation, exploration and invention. A research proposal is required to address problems emerging in the academic field and to resolve them. A research proposal is drafted to choose a subject title and focus upon resolving its problem for obtaining a degree at any level. The primary aim of writing a research proposal is precisely the resolution of problems. In educational and academic fields, it is written in subjects such as language, literature, political science, sociology, geography, philosophy and economics to obtain Master's, M.Phil. and doctoral degrees. The research proposal must be presented to the department of the relevant subject or the Dean's office of the university. Research ought to be conducted only after the said research proposal is approved by the department or the Dean's office. A research proposal must follow a distinct procedure that is scientific, methodical and systematic for research. In it, the scope of study, research title, research problem statement, research objectives, review of previous work, rationale and utility of the research, delimitations of the research, sources of data collection (primary and secondary sources), theoretical framework and research methodology (qualitative and quantitative), and outline of the research must be contained in the research proposal.

Research carried out in academic and educational fields works to solve problems, uncover new facts, and test and re-evaluate old ones. Research is also referred to as investigation, inquiry and discovery. A research proposal is needed to tackle problems that come up in academic fields and sort them out. A research proposal is put together to pick a topic title and zero in on solving its issues so as to gain a degree at any level. The chief point of writing a research proposal is getting problems solved. Across educational and academic settings, it is written across subjects like language, literature, political science, sociology, geography, philosophy and economics to finish Master's, M.Phil. and PhD degrees. The research proposal has to be handed in to the relevant subject department or the Dean's office at the university. Research should only be carried out once that research proposal gets the green light from the department or Dean's office. A research proposal needs to follow a specific process that is scientific, methodical and step-by-step. In it, the field of study, research title, research problem statement, research objectives, literature review, rationale and usefulness of the research, research delimitations, sources of data collection (primary and secondary sources), theoretical framework and research methodology (qualitative and quantitative), and research outline must all be in the research proposal.
informal_english: Solving all kinds of problems across the world really comes down to research. Doing academic and educational research is all about tackling problems, turning up fresh facts, and testing and rethinking older facts. Folks also call research investigating, digging around, or inventing. You need a solid research proposal to take on problems popping up in academia and sort them out. A research proposal is written up to pick a topic and really focus on solving the issue so you can snag a degree at whatever level. The main point of writing up a research proposal is simply solving the problem. In uni and school settings, people write them in language, literature, politics, sociology, geography, philosophy and economics to grab Master's, M.Phil. and PhD degrees. You’ve got to lodge the research proposal with the relevant department or the Dean's office at the uni. You only get cracking on the actual research once that proposal gets signed off by the department or Dean's office. A research proposal has to follow a proper, scientific, methodical, step-by-step process. In there, the study area, title, problem statement, research aims, literature review, justification and usefulness, delimitations, data collection sources (primary and secondary), theoretical setup and methodology (qualitative and quantitative), and the overall outline all have to be in the research proposal.
